name: Local Ambient Occlusion for Volume Rendering
aliases: Ambient Occlusion Volume Rendering with Local Vicinity Statistics
Local Ambient Occlusion (LAO) for Volume Rendering
Probabilistic Ambient Occlusion for Volume Rendering
definition: A rendering method that calculates ambient occlusion by considering the transparency around each sample in the volume, providing better spatial and depth cues than local illumination alone. It assumes CT values around a sample follow a normal distribution to estimate the probability of occlusion.
summary: Local Ambient Occlusion for Volume Rendering is a lighting model that computes shadowing based on local voxel statistics to provide depth cues without the cost of global illumination.
